common_behaviors_actions: Plotting intricate schemes to gain more power.
Studying ancient tomes of forbidden knowledge.
Seeking out artifacts and relics of immense power.
Vecna.name: Vecna
Vecna.damage_resistances: necrotic, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
Vecna.languages: Common, Draconic, Infernal, Elvish, telepathy 120 ft.
special_abilities: Undying Mastery: Vecna can never be truly destroyed as long as his phylactery remains intact.
Legendary Spellcasting: Vecna can cast spells as a 20th-level wizard and has access to all necromancy spells.

legendary_actions.Cast a Spell: Vecna casts one of his prepared spells.
legendary_actions.Hand of Vecna: Vecna can make a melee attack with the Hand of Vecna, dealing necrotic damage.

lair_actions: Vecna can cast the spell 'detect magic' without using a spell slot.
Vecna can cause spectral hands to rise from the ground and restrain a creature.
regional_effects: Dead creatures within 1 mile of Vecna's lair cannot be resurrected except by wish.
The area within 1 mile of Vecna's lair is shrouded in perpetual twilight.

common_behaviors_actions: Seeking out and manipulating Tatyana's reincarnations.
Strahd.name: Strahd
Strahd.damage_resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
special_abilities: Shapechanger: Strahd can polymorph into a bat, wolf, or mist.
Vampiric Regeneration: Strahd regains hit points each round as long as he has at least 1 hit point.

legendary_actions.Move: Strahd can move up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
legendary_actions.Unholy Sword: Strahd makes a melee attack with his Unholy Sword.

lair_actions: Strahd can summon a swarm of bats or rats to aid him in combat.
Strahd can cause shadows to darken within his lair, imposing disadvantage on attack rolls against him.
regional_effects: The area within 6 miles of Castle Ravenloft is perpetually covered in mist.
Strahd can exert control over Barovia, spying on its inhabitants and influencing events.

common_behaviors_actions: Relentlessly seeking ways to escape Ravenloft.
Ruling Darkon with a cold, iron fist.
Azalin.name: Azalin
Azalin.damage_resistances: necrotic, cold, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
Azalin.languages: Common, Draconic, Infernal, Elvish, telepathy 120 ft.
special_abilities: Undying Will: Azalin can never be truly destroyed as long as his phylactery remains intact.
Legendary Spellcasting: Azalin can cast spells as a 20th-level wizard and has access to all necromancy spells.

legendary_actions.Cast a Spell: Azalin casts one of his prepared spells.
legendary_actions.Paralyzing Touch: Azalin can make a melee attack that paralyzes his target.

lair_actions: Azalin can create an anti-magic field in a 30-foot radius around him.
Azalin can cause the dead to rise from the ground and fight for him.
regional_effects: Undead creatures within 1 mile of Azalin's lair gain resistance to necrotic damage.
The area within 1 mile of Azalin's lair is shrouded in a permanent fog, reducing visibility.

common_behaviors_actions: Riding his nightmare steed across the land.
Seeking out powerful artifacts to increase his power.
Soth.name: Soth
Soth.damage_resistances: necrotic, fire, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
special_abilities: Aura of Fear: Enemies within 10 feet of Soth must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.
Hellfire Orb: Soth can hurl an orb of hellfire that explodes on impact, dealing fire and necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.Move: Soth can move up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
legendary_actions.Hellfire Orb: Soth can use his Hellfire Orb ability as a legendary action.

lair_actions: Soth can summon ghostly knights to fight for him.
Soth can create a wall of flame that deals fire damage to creatures that pass through it.
regional_effects: The area within 1 mile of Soth's lair is filled with the sound of distant wailing and screams.
Undead creatures within 1 mile of Soth's lair gain advantage on saving throws against being turned.
